name: Elsight Limited
summary: Elsight Limited provides connectivity technology solutions. It offers Halo, a communication platform; and Multichannel, a platform through its high bandwidth adaptive data transmission channel communicates live data, video and audio, in real-time, anytime, anywhere by bonding multiple 3G/4G network, Wi-Fi, and/or satellite services; and Multichannel Backpack consisting of dual, long-range, and real-time cellular communications transmission, as well as security to the field with mobility. The company also provides vehicle connectivity solutions for HLS and automotive applications; medical solutions to transport telemedicine solution for medical professionals, emergency workers, and hospitals; and communication links to drones of various shapes and sizes which is used for entertainment, security, and defenses purposes; and Commander 360, a video management platform that enables various scenarios control, which dispatches video from the control center to operational unit in the field, commanders, and law enforcement agencies. It serves technology solutions to public security, banks, law enforcement, government offices, autonomous, fleet management, and military forces. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
